title: US firms in Europe broadly see stable transatlantic ties a year on from trade deal
title_zh: 欧洲的美国公司普遍认为贸易协议一年后跨大西洋关系稳定
summary: By Philip Blenkinsop BRUSSELS, July 27 (Reuters) - A majority of U.S. companies operating in Europe now expect stable transatlantic trade and investment relations, a marked improvement from their
summary_zh: 菲利普·布伦金索普 (Philip Blenkinsop) 布鲁塞尔，7 月 27 日（路透社）——大多数在欧洲开展业务的美国公司现在预计跨大西洋贸易和投资关系将保持稳定，这与它们在欧洲的贸易和投资关系相比有显着改善。

title: Blackstone credit arm nears deal for HSBC’s Australian loan book – report
title_zh: 黑石信贷部门即将完成汇丰银行澳大利亚贷款账簿的交易——报告
summary: HSBC is carrying out a broad global reorganisation under chief executive Georges Elhedery, who took the role last September.
summary_zh: 汇丰银行在去年 9 月上任的首席执行官 Georges Elhedery 的领导下正在进行广泛的全球重组。

title: Nvidia’s Rumored $600 Billion OpenAI Deal Could Reignite Its Biggest AI Controversy
title_zh: 传闻中 Nvidia 价值 6000 亿美元的 OpenAI 交易可能会重新引发其最大的人工智能争议
summary: Nvidia may be quietly transforming from a chip supplier into the financier of AI's most ambitious infrastructure bets, and critics say that shift raises uncomfortable questions about whether surging GPU demand is as organic as it appears.
summary_zh: 英伟达可能正在悄然从一家芯片供应商转型为人工智能最雄心勃勃的基础设施投资的融资者，批评人士表示，这种转变引发了令人不安的问题，即 GPU 需求的激增是否像表面上看起来的那样是有机的。

title: Nvidia Eyes OpenAI, SK Hynix Deals—Why the Stock Still Looks Like a Chip Laggard
title_zh: Nvidia 着眼于 OpenAI 和 SK Hynix 交易——为什么该股看起来仍然像芯片落后者
summary: The shares were up 1.1% to $209.16 in premarket trading, after falling 0.9% in the previous session. Nvidia has missed out on the chip rally this year, up just 11% compared with the  (SOX) 67% rise — the index that tracks the 30 biggest U.S.-listed companies connected to semi’s.
summary_zh: 该股在前一交易日下跌 0.9% 后，在盘前交易中上涨 1.1% 至 209.16 美元。英伟达错过了今年芯片股的涨势，与 (SOX) 67% 的涨幅相比，该指数仅上涨了 11%，该指数追踪与半导体相关的 30 家最大的美国上市公司。

title: Alphabet's YouTube Steal: $1.65 Billion Acquisition Now Pulls In $11 Billion In Quarterly Ad Revenue
title_zh: Alphabet 收购 YouTube：16.5 亿美元收购现已带来 110 亿美元季度广告收入
summary: Still known as Google at the time, the future Alphabet Inc announced a game-changing $1.65 billion acquisition for video platform YouTube on Oct. 9, 2006. The deal has transformed Alphabet and become one of the most profitable acquisitions of all...
summary_zh: 2006 年 10 月 9 日，未来的 Alphabet Inc 仍被称为 Google，宣布以 16.5 亿美元收购视频平台 YouTube，改变游戏规则。这笔交易改变了 Alphabet，并成为所有收购中利润最高的收购之一。
